# iosxe_voice_class_tenant (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class Tenant configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_tenant" "example" {
  tag                          = 100
  session_transport_tcp_tls    = true
  localhost                    = "dns:cube.example.com"
  header_passing               = true
  error_passthru               = true
  referto_passing              = true
  contact_passing              = true
  requri_passing               = true
  update_callerid              = true
  redirection                  = true
  random_contact               = true
  anat                         = false
  override_hostname            = false
  url_sips                     = true
  rel1xx_disable               = true
  early_offer_forced           = true
  privacy_policy_passthru      = true
  block_183_sdp                = "present"
  pass_thru_content_custom_sdp = true
  audio_forced                 = true
  connection_reuse             = true
  connection_reuse_via_port    = true
  handle_replaces              = true
  reason_header_override       = true
  host_registrar               = true
  max_forwards                 = 70
  g729_annexb_override         = true
  disable_early_media          = "180"
  asserted_id_pai              = true
  asymmetric_payload_full      = true
  midcall_signaling_passthru   = true
  srtp_negotiate_cisco         = true
  conn_reuse                   = true
  options_ping_interval        = 60
  pass_thru_headers_unsupp     = true
  pass_thru_content_unsupp     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class tenant tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `analog_dn` (String) A string representing the directory number to register
- `analog_dn_dial_peer_tag` (Number) POTS dial peer tag
  - Range: `1`-`1073741823`
- `anat` (Boolean) allow alternative network address types IPv4 and IPv6
- `asserted_id_pai` (Boolean) Use privacy asserted identity
- `asymmetric_payload_full` (Boolean) Asymmetric Support for dynamic codec and dtmf payloads
- `audio_forced` (Boolean) Allow only audio/fax, drop all other
- `authentication_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `authentication_password_type` (String) - Choices: `0`, `6`, `7`
- `authentication_password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `authentication_password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `authentication_realm` (String) Realm at which the credentials are applicable
- `authentication_realm_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `authentication_realm_password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `authentication_realm_password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `authentication_realm_username` (String) name of the user authenticating
- `authentication_username` (String) name of the user authenticating
- `bind_control_source_interface` (String) GigabitEthernet IEEE 802.3z
- `bind_control_source_interface_loopback` (Number) Loopback interface
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `bind_control_source_interface_port_channel` (Number) Ethernet Channel of interfaces
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `bind_control_source_interface_ten_gigabit_ethernet` (String) Ten Gigabit Ethernet
- `bind_media_source_interface` (String) GigabitEthernet IEEE 802.3z
- `bind_media_source_interface_loopback` (Number) Loopback interface
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `bind_media_source_interface_port_channel` (Number) Ethernet Channel of interfaces
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `bind_media_source_interface_ten_gigabit_ethernet` (String) Ten Gigabit Ethernet
- `block_183_sdp` (String) Block the response upon SDP presence/absence
  - Choices: `absent`, `present`
- `conn_reuse` (Boolean) reuse the sip registration tcp connection for the end-point behind a Firewall
- `connection_reuse` (Boolean) Use listener port for sending requests over UDP
- `connection_reuse_via_port` (Boolean) Send responses to port present in Via header
- `contact_passing` (Boolean) 302 contact needs to be passed through for CFWD
- `copy_list` (String) Configure list of entities to be sent to peer leg
- `credentials_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials_numbers))
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `disable_early_media` (String) Disable early-media cut through
  - Choices: `180`
- `early_offer_forced` (Boolean) Forcefully Send Early-Offer
- `error_passthru` (Boolean) SIP error response pass-thru functionality
- `g729_annexb_override` (Boolean) Override default value, yes, if annexb attribute is not present
- `handle_replaces` (Boolean) Handle INVITE with REPLACES header at SIP spi
- `header_passing` (Boolean) SIP Headers need to be passed to Applications
- `host_registrar` (Boolean) Use sip-ua registrar value in Diversion and Contact header for 3xx messages
- `listen_port_non_secure` (Number) Change UDP/TCP SIP listen port (have bind configured under this tenant for the config to take effect)
  - Range: `5000`-`5500`
- `listen_port_secure` (Number) Change TLS SIP listen port (have bind configured under this tenant for the config to take effect)
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `localhost` (String) Specify the DNS name for the localhost
- `max_forwards` (Number) Change number of max-forwards for SIP Methods
  - Range: `1`-`70`
- `midcall_signaling_passthru` (Boolean) Passthrough SIP messages from one IP leg to another IP leg
- `options_ping_interval` (Number) Intervals OPTIONS transactions are sent (in seconds)
  - Range: `60`-`1200`
- `outbound_proxy` (String) Specify Outbound Proxy Address
- `override_hostname` (Boolean) Override registrar hostname with resolved IP address in SIP message headers
- `pass_thru_content_custom_sdp` (Boolean) Pass-through Custom SDP using SIP Profiles
- `pass_thru_content_unsupp` (Boolean) Pass-through all unsupported content
- `pass_thru_headers_unsupp` (Boolean) Pass-through all unsupported headers
- `privacy_policy_passthru` (Boolean) Pass through privacy values received from peer leg
- `random_contact` (Boolean) Use Random Contact for outgoing calls, if available
- `reason_header_override` (Boolean) Enable Reason header to override SIP<->Q850 Mappings
- `redirection` (Boolean) Enable call redirection (3XX) handling
- `referto_passing` (Boolean) Refer-To needs to be passed through for transfer
- `registrar_primary` (String)
- `registrar_primary_expires` (Number) Default registration expires time
  - Range: `60`-`65535`
- `registrar_primary_refresh_ratio` (Number) Default registration refresh ratio
  - Range: `1`-`100`
- `registrar_primary_scheme` (String) URL scheme - sips or sip
  - Choices: `sip`, `sips`
- `registrar_secondary` (String)
- `registrar_secondary_refresh_ratio` (Number) Default registration refresh ratio
  - Range: `1`-`100`
- `rel1xx_disable` (Boolean) Disables reliable-provisional responses
- `remote_party_id` (Boolean) Enable Remote-Party-ID support in SIP User Agent calls
- `requri_passing` (Boolean) Request URI needs to be passed through
- `retry_invite` (Number) INVITE retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_register` (Number) REGISTER retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_rel1xx` (Number) Reliable 1xx retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_response` (Number) Response retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `session_transport_tcp` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - TCP
- `session_transport_tcp_tls` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - TLS over TCP
- `session_transport_udp` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - UDP
- `sip_profiles` (String) The sip profiles tag number to be linked as global
- `sip_profiles_inbound` (Boolean) Set this as inbound SIP Profile
- `sip_server` (String) Configure a SIP Server Interface
- `srtp_crypto` (String) Configure the voice class srtp-crypto tag
- `srtp_negotiate_cisco` (Boolean) allow RTP answer to SRTP offer
- `timers_connect` (Number) Time to wait for confirmation a session connected
  - Range: `100`-`1000`
- `timers_expires` (Number) Time to wait for the expiration of an INVITE request
  - Range: `60000`-`1800000`
- `timers_trying` (Number) Time to wait for provisional response to INVITE
  - Range: `100`-`1000`
- `tls_profile` (Number) Specify the tls-profile tag number
  - Range: `1`-`10000`
- `update_callerid` (Boolean) Enable sending updates for callerid
- `url_sip` (Boolean) SIP URL in outgoing request uri
- `url_sips` (Boolean) SECURE SIP (sips) URL in outgoing request uri

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_tenant.example "<tag>"
```
